difficulty_reason: For a flat morphism over the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring with connected source and reduced special fibre, the lemma proves the generic fibre is connected. The proof uses flatness to prevent components from appearing only in the special fibre, and the reducedness of the special fibre to see that the connection between components persists after passing to the generic fibre. Combining flatness with reducedness of the special fibre is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 8148-8163.
